questions.prompt: Which Act created the office of Governor-General of Bengal?
questions.explanation: The Regulating Act 1773 created the office of Governor-General of Bengal. The Charter Act 1833 later made the Governor-General of Bengal the Governor-General of India.

questions.prompt: Under the Government of India Act 1919, where was dyarchy introduced?
questions.explanation: The 1919 Act introduced provincial dyarchy: subjects were divided into reserved and transferred groups. Do not confuse this with the proposed central dyarchy under the 1935 Act.

questions.prompt: Which feature of the Government of India Act 1935 did not come into operation?
questions.explanation: The proposed All-India Federation was not established. Provincial autonomy came into operation in 1937; an Act's provisions and their implementation dates must be studied separately.
